description: This file defines the main frontend application component for a to-do planning app built with React. It includes the root App component, a nested AppShell component that manages theme settings, keyboard shortcuts, and layout featuring header, task input, filters, task list, and settings panel.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main application component that wraps the UI with TodoProvider to supply state and actions.

methods.name: AppShell()
methods.description: Internal component that consumes context and renders the core application structure, managing theme attributes, keyboard shortcuts, and rendering individual sections.

methods.name: closeSettings
methods.description: Function to close the settings panel by updating the state via actions.

methods.name: handleAddTask
methods.description: Function that handles adding a task; focuses or submits the task input based on current focus and value.

methods.name: handleCancelOrClose
methods.description: Function that closes the settings panel if it is open.

methods.name: handleFocusFilters
methods.description: Function that sets focus to the first focusable element within the filters section.

methods.name: handleToggleHelp
methods.description: Function that logs shortcut instructions to the console.
